# @contractkit/plugin-markdown

> **Deprecated.** Superseded by `@contractkit/plugin-docs` and its `markdown` target. This package
> is now a thin re-export and will be removed in a future major.

## Migrating

```json
{
    "plugins": {
        "@contractkit/plugin-docs": {
            "markdown": { "baseDir": "docs/" }
        }
    }
}
```

Every option keeps its name and meaning; the output is unchanged. See
`packages/plugin-docs/llms.txt` for the full option table and the other targets.

## More

- Migration notes: https://github.com/MaroonedSoftware/contractkit/blob/main/packages/plugin-markdown/README.md
- Replacement: https://github.com/MaroonedSoftware/contractkit/blob/main/packages/plugin-docs/llms.txt
